headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0 in a thrilling victory. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured an 8-4 win over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 9-5. 

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Abner Uribe of the Milwaukee Brewers being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Other notable injuries include Colt Emerson of the Seattle Mariners, Davis Martin of the Chicago White Sox, Matt Chapman of the San Francisco Giants, Trevor McDonald of the San Francisco Giants, Garrett Whitlock of the Boston Red Sox, James Outman of the Detroit Tigers, and Endy Rodríguez of the Pittsburgh Pirates.

Several trades and roster movements have occurred, including Harold Rivas being traded to the Baltimore Orioles from the Boston Red Sox as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. Additionally, Jacob Berry was traded to the Kansas City Royals from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a stellar 7.0 innings, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a crucial double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the offense. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Boston Red Sox sent Rivas to the Orioles in exchange for a player to be named later.
